description: Hand-labelled evaluation set for the Atlas corpus. `gold_sources` is the document(s) that actually contain the answer -- that is the retrieval label. `must_contain` are strings the answer text must include -- that is the generation label. Questions tagged 'unanswerable' are NOT in the corpus and the system is expected to abstain with NOT_FOUND.
